summary.text: Frank Iler is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 17 in Brunswick County who has served since 2009 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists him as retired, and Ballotpedia says he worked as an accountant and business owner before retiring.

paragraphs.text: Iler graduated from Greensboro Senior High School and earned a B.A. in business from Campbell University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says that he and his wife, Jackie, live in Oak Island, North Carolina.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.

Iler chairs the House Transportation Committee, the Appropriations Subcommittee on Transportation and the House Select Committee on North Carolina's Transportation Future, and he is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee.
He co-chairs the Joint Legislative Transportation Oversight Committee.
